    Examples

    Example: UnderLine

    ![../_images/UnderLine-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/UnderLine-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class UnderLine(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            man = Tex("Manim")  # Full Word
            ul = Underline(man)  # Underlining the word
            self.add(man, ul)
    ```
